title: As Far as the Eyes Can See
description: A close-up of a king scallop (Pecten maximus), which can have hundreds of complex eyes. Found on the edge of the mantle lining the scallop’s shell, each eye contains a microscopic mirror made of guanine crystals. Unlike mammal eyes that contain one retina, the mirrors in a scallop’s eyes reflect and focus light onto two separate retinas.
translated_description: 一只大扇贝（Pecten maximus）的特写镜头，这种扇贝可能拥有数百只结构复杂的眼睛。这些眼睛位于扇贝壳边缘的套膜衬里上，每只眼睛都含有一面由鸟嘌呤晶体构成的微型镜子。与哺乳动物仅含一个视网膜的眼睛不同，扇贝眼睛中的镜子能将光线反射并聚焦到两个独立的视网膜上。
